name: Junior Volunteers (Charlottesville-Albemarle SPCA)
what_you_do: Help with community service tasks at the animal shelter and rummage store. Volunteers are part of the shelter's daily work. Tasks depend on the SPCA's needs and your skills.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 and older. The page welcomes volunteers ages 14 and up. Groups with people under 18 need at least one adult chaperone for every 10 children.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The volunteer pays a $25 volunteer fee plus a separate $9 background check. The page does not say if either is refundable.
duration: Ongoing. Hours and length are not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline. Pick an orientation date on the SPCA's calendar.
how_to_apply: Use the Schedule Orientation or Volunteer Application link on the SPCA volunteer page to choose an orientation date and fill out the volunteer application. Orientation comes before you take on tasks. Contact: volunteer@caspca.org or 434-973-5959 ext. 314.
notes: The pages do not say if 14 to 17 year olds need a parent signature. They do not say if there are limits on which animals teens can work with. Ask at orientation. The apply link goes to the SPCA's event calendar on a third party site.
